dataCatalog.name: Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme (IDSP) Weekly Outbreak Reports
dataCatalog.authority: National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), MoHFW, Govt. of India
dataCatalog.license: Government Open Data License - India (GODL-India) / NDSAP
missingFields: screenedCount (denominator not reported in municipal bulletins)
knownBiases: Reporting delays between clinical onset and publication (7 to 14 days)
Syndromic reporting variation across primary vs tertiary institutions
Testing volume unobserved in non-laboratory notifications
dataCatalog.handlingPolicy: Screened denominator preserved strictly as undefined; positivity rate is not calculated if denominator is missing.

dataCatalog.name: CockroachDB Sentinel Hospital Outbreak Ledger (DiseaseOutbreakSignal)
dataCatalog.license: Internal Enterprise / HIPAA & DISHA Compliant De-Identified Telemetry
dataCatalog.geographicCoverage: Anchor facilities (Delhi, Maharashtra, Kerala, Karnataka, UP)
dataCatalog.reportingUnit: Daily event stream / Kiosk intake aggregation
dataCatalog.handlingPolicy: Normalized to ISO region hierarchy and ICD-10 taxonomy.

dataCatalog.name: Region X 8/10 Controlled Outbreak Cluster Scenario
dataCatalog.handlingPolicy: Demonstrates small-sample uncertainty, Wilson CI [49%-94%], and Bayesian smoothing to prevent false individual diagnostic certainty.
